units.rawText: Phew, all this talking wore me out... I've already worked for 30 minutes! So now it's slacking time~ Professor, for the sake of our physical and mental health, let's ditch work together!

units.rawText: P-Professor?! I wasn't spacing out, okay? Seeing this work scene just reminded me of the past.

units.rawText: Ahem. I used to have a colleague I worked with. She worked tirelessly, nonstop, until one day she got scrapped in an accident during a destructive test... And the lesson here is: if you work, you die!

units.rawText: To live well for both of us, every day I summon my courage, go against my conscience, and slack off with all my might. You understand how hard I'm trying, right, Professor?
